Title: Transfer to Self Not Blocked
Repro Steps:
1. Navigate to Transfer page
2. Enter your own account number as recipient
3. Enter any amount (e.g., $50)
4. Click Transfer Money button
5. Observe transfer completes successfully
Acceptance Criteria: System should validate recipient account and prevent self-transfers with appropriate error message

Title: Negative Transfer Amounts Accepted
Repro Steps:
1. Go to Transfer page
2. Enter any valid recipient account number
3. Enter a negative amount (e.g., -50)
4. Submit the transfer
5. Observe balance increases instead of decreases
Acceptance Criteria: System should only accept positive amounts and reject negative values with validation error

Title: Transaction History Wrong Order
Repro Steps:
1. Make multiple transfers over time
2. Navigate to Transaction History page
3. Observe transactions are listed oldest-first
4. Newest transactions appear at bottom instead of top
Acceptance Criteria: Transactions should display in reverse chronological order (newest first) by default

Title: Loading Spinner Never Stops on Login
Repro Steps:
1. Enter demo credentials (demo@bank.com / demo123)
2. Click Sign In button
3. Wait for successful login
4. Observe loading spinner continues indefinitely
5. Spinner remains visible even after login completes
System Info: Android 12, Chrome Mobile 120.0, Samsung Galaxy S21
Acceptance Criteria: Loading spinner should disappear immediately after successful login completion

Title: Notifications Don't Auto-Dismiss
Repro Steps:
1. Perform multiple actions that generate notifications
2. Observe all notifications remain visible
3. Notifications stack up and never disappear automatically
4. Must manually close each notification
Acceptance Criteria: Notifications should auto-dismiss after 5 seconds and not accumulate on screen

Title: Mobile Layout Breaks on Transfer Form
Repro Steps:
1. Resize browser to mobile width (<400px) or use device tools
2. Navigate to Transfer page
3. Scroll to bottom of transfer form
4. Observe button and fee text overlap/clip
Acceptance Criteria: Transfer form should remain fully visible and functional on all mobile screen sizes

Title: Invalid Email Validation
Repro Steps:
1. Go to registration page
2. Enter 'test@' in email field (incomplete email)
3. Fill other required fields correctly
4. Submit registration form
5. Form accepts invalid email format
Acceptance Criteria: Email validation should reject incomplete formats and require proper domain structure

Title: Password Requirements Not Enforced
Repro Steps:
1. Navigate to registration page
2. Enter weak password like '123' or 'abc'
3. Notice requirements are displayed but not validated
4. Submit form with weak password
5. Account creation succeeds despite weak password
Acceptance Criteria: Password validation should enforce 8+ characters with complexity requirements as displayed

Title: Transaction History Slow Load Without Pagination
Repro Steps:
1. Navigate to Transaction History page
2. Observe loading takes exactly 3 seconds every time
3. No pagination controls available for large datasets
4. All transactions load at once regardless of count
System Info: All browsers, All OS, Any transaction count
Acceptance Criteria: Transaction history should load quickly with pagination for performance optimization

Title: Scientific Notation in Transfer Amount
Repro Steps:
1. Go to Transfer page
2. Enter '1e2' in the amount field (scientific notation)
3. Submit transfer
4. Observe potential display or calculation inconsistencies
5. Amount may not display properly in history
Acceptance Criteria: Amount field should only accept decimal format or properly convert scientific notation

Title: Dashboard Account Cards Not Responsive
Repro Steps:
1. Open dashboard on mobile device
2. View account cards section
3. Cards overflow horizontally on small screens
4. Horizontal scrolling required to see all accounts
Acceptance Criteria: Account cards should stack vertically or wrap properly on mobile devices

Title: Transfer Form Validation Bypassed
Repro Steps:
1. Open Transfer page
2. Leave recipient field empty
3. Enter amount and description
4. Use browser dev tools to remove 'required' attribute
5. Submit form bypasses client-side validation
Acceptance Criteria: Server-side validation should catch bypassed client-side validation attempts

Title: Session Timeout Not Handled
Repro Steps:
1. Login to application
2. Leave browser idle for extended period
3. Attempt to perform transaction after timeout
4. No session expiry warning or automatic logout
5. User may see unexpected errors
Acceptance Criteria: Application should handle session timeout gracefully with warnings and auto-logout

Title: Accessibility Issues in Forms
Repro Steps:
1. Use screen reader software
2. Navigate through login and registration forms
3. Tab through form fields
4. Observe missing labels and poor focus indicators
5. Form validation errors not announced
Acceptance Criteria: All forms should be fully accessible with proper labels, focus management, and error announcements

Title: Cross-Site Scripting in Description Field
Repro Steps:
1. Go to Transfer page
2. Enter script tag in description field: <script>alert('XSS')</script>
3. Submit transfer
4. View transaction in history
5. Script may execute when viewing transaction details
Acceptance Criteria: All user input should be properly sanitized to prevent XSS attacks
